thread:
mina-support: FYI customer ACME reports they found a Redwood API key inside a mobile crash dump uploaded to Sentry. They attached a stacktrace and a snippet showing the key in plaintext. They say traffic spiked ~5x and bill jumped. Requesting immediate rotation + audit + short term mitigation.

ash-cs: ack. Can we disable the key immediately? They need a new key rotated and guidance for mobile. P0 for billing exposure.

lee-secops: copy. First step: disable the leaked key so it can't be used. I'll need the key id. Mina, can you paste the key id (partial ok) and customer account ID?

mina-support: Key id provided in customer email: rk_live_7f8a2b9c. Account: acct_ACME_987. They also included Sentry event url: https://sentry.io/organizations/acme/issues/987654321/

ash-cs: sending the rotation doc to customer and offering a short-lived replacement key for immediate fix. Also offering to reimburse the overage while we investigate.

lee-secops: I'll temporarily rate-limit that key at the gateway and disable create-token endpoints for it. Then we rotate. Take these steps:
1) Disable key via internal admin portal (ACL change) or API.
2) Issue new key with least privileges.
3) Force mobile app to fetch new credential via our token exchange (avoid baking long-lived keys).

mina-support: doing disable now:

```
# internal admin CLI
redwood admin keys disable rk_live_7f8a2b9c --reason "suspected leak"
```

mina-support: Done. Response: 204. Key status: disabled.

deploy-bot: :rotating_light: Key rk_live_7f8a2b9c disabled by mina-support (reason: suspected leak)

lee-secops: good. Next: create new key and make it short-lived for mobile until they roll out an app update. Recommend using our ephemeral token flow with STS-backed exchange. Example flow for server side:

```
POST /v1/tokens/exchange
{
  "type": "ephemeral",
  "scopes": ["generate","embeddings"],
  "ttl": 3600
}
```

Return ephemeral token to mobile; never store long-lived key in app bundle.

acme-integration: thanks, appreciate the quick response. Our mobile release is next week; can we have a temporary key that expires in 24h while we push the fix? Also want to know all requests from the leaked key and whether any data was exfiltrated.

mina-support: I'll generate a 24h key and hand it to your server team. Also starting audit query for all requests made with the disabled key across last 72h.

lee-secops: Audit notes: use console -> Audit logs or our internal audit API to enumerate calls. Sample query:

```
GET /v1/admin/audit?actor_key=rk_live_7f8a2b9c&from=2026-03-14&to=2026-03-17
```

Look for actions: create_chat, embeddings, billing.events. We also need the IPs, user-agents, and request payload sizes.

mina-support: running query now. Returning topline: ~12k requests, majority text-gen, ~3 distinct IP ranges (one looks like a botnet), average tokens per request 250. No obvious data exfil pattern in payloads (we're scanning but need sec-tools to run deep inspection).

lee-secops: escalate to sec-forensics to do content-scan for PII and sensitive prompts. @sarah-privacy please join — customer may need notification depending on data retention/compliance.

sarah-privacy: on it. We need to know retention windows and whether any requests touched customer-managed data stores. Also confirm if logs include prompt text or only metadata.

mina-support: Logs include full request/response payloads in our debug retention (30 days for debug, 365 days for audit logs by default for enterprise). This account is standard, so debug payloads kept 30 days.

lee-secops: For customers who want stricter controls we have options: private deployment / VPC, disable storing request bodies, or configure prompt redaction. Recommend customer enable request body redaction and integrate KMS envelope encryption for stored blobs.

acme-integration: They asked about KMS/HSM — can you confirm we can wrap keys with their KMS and rotate? They also asked for proof for compliance team.

lee-secops: Yes, for Enterprise we support customer-managed KMS integration. We can create keys wrapped by their KMS (CMKs) and store wrapped blobs in HSM-backed keystore. For this incident, recommend:
- Rotate to a new key generated server-side, wrapped with their KMS.
- Use short TTL ephemeral tokens for mobile (STS exchange).
- Remove any long-lived keys from app binaries and CI.

mina-support: I'm drafting step-by-step guide for the customer and attaching minimal commands for rotation:

```
# create new key (admin only)
POST /v1/admin/keys
{
  "name": "acme-mobile-temp",
  "scopes": ["generate"],
  "ttl": 86400,
  "wrap_kms": "projects/acme/kms/keyRING/keys/rdw-wrap"
}
```

Then update server config and trigger a config push to mobile backend.

ash-cs: I'll coordinate push and offer a credit for the unexpected billing. Also opening ticket with billing to freeze charges while we investigate abuse vectors.

lee-secops: After rotation, run these checks:
- Verify no new requests accepted with old key.
- Confirm ephemeral tokens issued properly and ops rollback if app still uses old baked key.
- Review role policies for key creation endpoints to ensure principle of least privilege.

mina-support: Forensics team found no obvious PII leaks but will continue scanning. I'll share a redacted CSV of suspicious request IDs.

acme-integration: good. Please also provide a short incident summary we can share with our compliance team (timeline, mitigation, evidence).

sarah-privacy: we'll prepare a one-page summary: what happened, which customers affected (just ACME), timeline of disable/rotation, audit results so far, retention policies, and remediation steps.

lee-secops: final items: add an allowlist for their backend IPs for new key, turn on stricter rate limiting for ephemeral keys by default, and run an org-wide sweep for hardcoded tokens in recent mobile repo commits (we have a grep job).

mina-support: created support ticket SUP-2026-472 and attached all artifacts. Assigned to lee-secops and ash-cs.

deploy-bot: :white_check_mark: Support ticket SUP-2026-472 opened by mina-support.

ash-cs: I'll follow up with ACME in 30m with next steps and temporary creds. Leaving notes: reimburse overage pending investigation.

lee-secops: assigning to sec-forensics to finish content scan. We'll update this thread when we have final findings.

mina-support: closing loop for now — key disabled, temporary 24h key issued, audit query kicked off, ticket open. Will update with forensics results and billing freeze confirmation. :lock:
